text: A variant of K1 and K2's table uses two scrambled alphabets, one to look up the message letter and one to write the carved letter. Both may be any order; the known letters decide exactly which key lengths any pair can fit.
Per length, the 24 equations are solved modulo 13 and 2 and searched for two one-to-one alphabets. The share of scrambled coppers that fail is the test's power at that length.
K4 fits at 8, 13, 16, 19, 20, 23, 24 and 26 and nowhere else. Every length but 19 is inside the coppers' range; 19 (3 of 100) was replicated in 0124.
